confirmed_local_constraints.detail: validateCreatorProps currently accepts 240-1440 frames, up to 24 scenes, and 24-192 frames per scene. Business media is restricted to the first and last scenes.
validate_story permits 15/30/45/60 seconds. allocate_scenes is duration-agnostic but requires each allocated scene to stay at or below 192 frames.

The render entry and composition ID are currently hardcoded to creatorEntry.tsx / CreatorShort. Evidence freeze, staged media decode, stills, safe-area image, 24fps PNG rendering and final frame-count verification are reusable.
The Claude-work wrapper enforces 30 seconds and seven scenes. Do not relax it for this comparison.

recommended_boundary.legacy_policy: Keep CreatorShort defaults, limits, business first/last media restrictions, previously completed source frames and completed videos unchanged.
recommended_boundary.duration_validation: Dedicated comparison validator accepts an integer total of 1440-2160 frames; scenes must cover it without gaps or overlap, captions must stay within it. Actual delivery length is chosen after Aoede speech measurement.
recommended_boundary.render_route: Use a comparison-specific render entry/ID. If shared rendering is refactored, retain the existing creator route as the default with identical behavior and frozen sources.

reusable_parts: ScreenTypography and bundled Noto Sans JP font
CreatorCaption with business styling and existing caption-safe area
SHORTS_SAFE, displayUnits, outCubic, deterministic frame-based animation
Business official-source scene rendering through EditorialScene without changing source pixels
Official capture provenance, closed URL allowlist, staging, hash checks and capture-render-validation
MiniMax media path/proof, muted OffthreadVideo playback and full decode checks
Measured speech segment allocation, caption phrase timing, local sound design and final AAC/MP4 verification

proposed_scene_kinds.purpose: New Morikawa Haruka motion video for the question, insight, and final choice. Use actual generated MP4, not an animated still.
proposed_scene_kinds.constraint: A dedicated comparison scene allows the midpoint shot without weakening the existing business scene rules. Each selected clip interval must fit the actual MP4 duration.

proposed_scene_kinds.purpose: Two or three actual official-page excerpts, kept visible for roughly 5-7 seconds each with source credit.
proposed_scene_kinds.constraint: Use the existing explicit official origin contract and evidence; do not use illustrative cards as product screenshots.
All product names, conditions, labels and narration come from the verified script. No hardcoded product capability claims. Main comparisons use two stacked lanes for phone readability.

motion_direction.signal: Sequential arrival of message cards and a distinct clock marker only where the script identifies scheduled work. Do not equate self-initiated follow-up with a time schedule.
motion_direction.workspace: A central cloud work area with separate human-observation, takeover and permissioned-local-machine paths. Only verified paths appear. Arrows animate their direction and the active path gains emphasis.
motion_direction.availability: Three large eligibility chips for region, invitation/rollout, and usage allowance. Each condition appears in turn; no dense plan matrix or tiny caveats.
motion_direction.decision: Two vertically stacked use-case cards followed by one short question. The result is a task-based choice rather than a winner/loser ranking.
motion_direction.fictional_case: Use the same fictional cafe's schedule check and meeting preparation as an explicitly labeled request example. Do not present it as a real product execution test unless separately captured.
motion_direction.transitions: Short restrained fades and shape motion; avoid repeated zoom-only shots and decorative text animations that compete with the narration.

readability.source_pixels: Actual UI captures require native-scale readable text and lossless PNG. Do not mask low resolution by artificial upscaling or redrawing a quoted UI.

validation_before_delivery: Official source support and character-video proof reviewed before freezing narration
No TTS until the parent approves the verified script and evidence
Compare old CreatorShort fixture PNG hashes if shared rendering code changes
Negative tests for duration, caption timing, unsupported scene layout, missing proof and out-of-range media interval
Inspect all 14 scene frames at 1080x1920 and a phone-size view, including the midpoint insight video
Full-frame text-safe-area guard, complete video decode, measured narration duration and final listening review
Document architecture and Mermaid flow separately when implementation is approved
